endpoints.basis: Final score-attack search windows from cache/analysis report, excluding trailing transfer noise or silence; inspect exact pitch/attack overlays before publication.

provenance: Read content/listen/beethoven-appassionata-andante.mjs and cache/analysis/beethoven-appassionata-andante.txt. Author independently supplied broad formal-section estimates from harmonic trajectories and note-density changes; these are coarse diagnostic locators, not hand-marked individual attacks.
Published MIDI tracks were inspected against the original piano staves and not separated by register. Cross-staff entries remain source staff allocations, not fictitious independent voices.
